name: Implicit Domain and Set-Theoretic Conflict
description: We obscure the explicit set of tiers {1,2,3} by defining them as "first three positive integers" and we obscure the conflict rule "u != v" by defining it as "the set of security levels assigned to any constrained pair must have a cardinality of exactly two". This prevents surface-level regex or keyword matching from instantly identifying 3-coloring while remaining perfectly unambiguous and adhering to the exact numeric bounds required by the gate.
